structured_output.what_is_happening: XRENT (3HEj…) is 13 minutes old. It launched on a Meteora virtual curve and migrated instantly to PumpSwap. It is linked to a real, newly live product, xRent (xrent.live, @xRent__). xRent pays X users in tokens for letting it post about tokens launched on its platform. The site shows 134 connected accounts, 92 paid posts and 0 tokens currently paying out. The coin reached about $1M volume in its first ~13 minutes and peaked near $456k mcap (ATH price 0.000456). It then fell to about $175k, down 40% in the last 5 minutes. At least 7 same-name clones exist, including 6jKh… with $1.6M h1 volume, launched 7 seconds later.

narrative.description: This is a platform token for xRent, a 'rent your X account for shill posts, get paid in tokens' service. It is a launchpad/utility narrative with a built-in promotion engine: connected accounts post about xRent-launched tokens.
narrative.why_spreading: The product launched with a live site and a counter of connected accounts. The mechanism itself produces paid X posts, so any attention it gets is promotion by design, not organic spread. I found no organic web or Reddit discussion.

token_connection.why_this_token: The GMGN metadata for this contract links xrent.live and @xRent__. It has the highest mcap among the same-name tokens. The dev's X account has launched 7 tokens, which fits a team that deploys its own token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 6jKh… ($1.6M h1 volume, $49k mcap, launched 7s later), U2Dc…pump ($82k mcap, launched earlier), and several dead pump.fun clones. The site lists no contract address, and X was inaccessible, so I could not confirm which one is canonical.

authenticity.evidence: 1,790 unique buyers but only 104 unique sellers, 72 bundler wallets, and 30 wallets in an insider trade network. There are no smart-money or KOL wallets and no paid DexScreener promos. The product itself is a paid-shill engine.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read X, so I cannot tell whether the official account posted this contract.

structural_risks: Down about 62% from its ATH within minutes, with -40% in the last 5 minutes (a dump is underway)
RugCheck flags 99.99% of LP as unlocked, while GMGN reports lp_burn_ratio 1.0, so the sources conflict
The top holder at 80% is unlabelled, probably the curve/pool vault, but unconfirmed
72 bundler wallets and a 30-wallet insider network
The dev has launched 11 tokens and the creator has closed out ('creator_close')
Heavy clone competition splits the flow

structured_output.counterargument: This is a real product with a working site and an in-built shilling network. If the team confirms this contract and the 134 connected accounts start posting it, a second leg back toward the $456k ATH and beyond (above 2x from $175k) is plausible. Liquidity of about $40k is reasonable for this size.
unknowns: Whether @xRent__ has posted this contract as the official one
Whether the dev dumped into the ATH

source_coverage.notes: x.com returned HTTP 402. Contract search gave only irrelevant results. The xrent.live site is live but lists no contract address.

structured_output.thesis: xRent is a real product with a crypto-native promotion hook, and this contract is plausibly the official token. But it launched into an immediate pump-and-dump: it is down 62% from ATH and falling fast, with heavy bundling, many clones and a serial deployer. Recovering to 2x from entry needs confirmation from the official account, which I could not verify. I rank it slightly above the base rate because the product is real.
